name: Hanyu Group Joint-Stock Co., Ltd.
summary: Hanyu Group Joint-Stock Co., Ltd. researches, develops, produces, and sells drainage pumps for household appliances in China. The company offers automotive electronic water pumps, oil pumps, AC / DC charging piles, and other products. It also provides spa toilet, harmonic reducers, mechatronic actuators, and robot joint modules. The company was formerly known as Jiangmen iDear-Hanyu Electrical Joint-Stock Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Hanyu Group Joint-Stock Co., Ltd. in December 2019. Hanyu Group Joint-Stock Co., Ltd. was founded in 2002 and is based in Jiangmen, China.
